company.name: IoTFlows
company.shortDescription: IoTFlows is a software firm that offers AI-powered machine performance monitoring IoT solutions.
company.description: IoTFlows offers AI-powered machine performance monitoring products. IoTFlows creates internet of things (IoT) hardware and network infrastructure. To send data from their sensors, machines, and processes to the cloud, businesses use the hardware and software of IoTFlows. IoTFlows actively participates in open source initiatives with the intention of assisting the developer community.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform to connect, control, and manage fleets of IoT devices, enabling real-time data exchange and device monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: IoTFlows Console

productsAndServices.description: A service providing secure remote access to devices for control, monitoring, programming, and file transfer over the internet.
productsAndServices.name: Remote Connect

productsAndServices.description: A system to connect, monitor, and manage IoT device fleets remotely, including software updates, file management, and real-time data publishing.
productsAndServices.name: Device Management

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-hosted Node-RED environment for building and orchestrating event-driven IoT workflows and integrating real-time data streams.
productsAndServices.name: Cloud Node-RED Server

productsAndServices.description: A system to create and send critical alerts and notifications via email, SMS, or push to designated users and channels for continuous monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Alerts & Notifications

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that supports team collaboration with role-based permissions, notifications, and shared dashboards for IoT device management.
productsAndServices.name: Collaborative Workspace
